skills.name: findash
skills.description: Turn a small business's monthly revenue, costs and budget into a profit and loss (P&L) summary with FinDash (findash.tech) - costs in four groups, gross and net profit, net margin, budget vs actual, and the months that made a loss or went over budget. Use when someone asks how their business did month by month, wants their P&L or budget explained, or wants their figures in the FinDash dashboard. Free, no account or API key.
